skill.description: Checks ad-to-page continuity, offer visibility, page speed, form friction, and mobile rendering before campaign launch. Returns a clear punch list without rewriting the page.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and relative documentation links. The documented Python scraper command is confirmed, and arbitrary user-supplied URL fetching creates a separate SSRF risk. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.issue: The scraper accepts a user-supplied destination URL without stated network-boundary checks.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTP and HTTPS, block private, loopback, link-local, and metadata addresses, and revalidate every redirect.

remediation.issue: The skill directs the agent to execute a Python connector with user-derived input.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured connector call with separate arguments, validate the URL first, and avoid shell interpolation.

content.user_title: Check Landing Page Experience Before Launch
content.value_statement: Paid ads lose relevance when landing pages do not match their promises. This skill checks five launch factors and returns specific fixes.
actual_capabilities: Compares ad headlines and claims with landing page copy for message-match gaps.
Checks whether the offer and primary call to action appear above the fold.
Uses provided speed or rendered-page data and labels results as measured or estimated.
Counts required form fields and identifies friction points without redesigning the form.
Reviews mobile visibility, readability, tap targets, forms, and horizontal scrolling.
Produces a five-check punch list and routes each repair to its owning skill.
limitations: Does not rewrite page copy, redesign layouts, or calculate account-level scores.
Cannot verify continuity when neither ad copy nor landing page content is available.
Speed and mobile conclusions remain estimated without measured PageSpeed, CrUX, or rendered-page data.
Rendered-page checks require an available connector and permitted network access.

use_cases.title: Preflight a Campaign Launch
use_cases.description: Check ads and their destination page before approving campaign launch.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Low Landing Experience
use_cases.description: Identify message, speed, form, or mobile factors behind a weak landing-page rating.

use_cases.title: Standardize Marketing Quality Checks
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable Pass, Partial, or Fix review for campaign operations.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [URL] against these ad headlines: [headlines]. Mark message match, offer visibility, speed, form friction, and mobile as Pass, Partial, or Fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a complete launch check.

prompt_templates.title: Check Message Continuity
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this ad promise with the landing page: [ad copy] and [page copy]. Identify unsupported, softened, or clearly matched claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advertiser wants a focused relevance review.

prompt_templates.title: Use Measured Performance Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [URL], [ad copy], and these PageSpeed or CrUX results: [data]. Separate measured findings from estimates and name each launch blocker.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Advanced Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [campaign inputs]. Produce five check results, evidence labels, exact gaps, repair owners, and a concise handoff for the next reviewer.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs an auditable launch decision.

output_examples.input: Ad promises a 30 percent discount, but the page headline only says seasonal savings.
output: Message match: Fix. The page does not confirm the advertised discount.
Owner: offer claims registry, then landing optimizer.
Launch status: Hold until the exact offer appears on the page.

output_examples.input: The page has eight required fields and no measured speed report.
output: Form friction: Fix. Eight required fields create avoidable completion effort.
Speed: Estimated. Provide PageSpeed or CrUX data for a measured result.
Mobile: Partial. Verify form controls and tap targets in a narrow viewport.

output_examples.input: Ad and page claims match, the offer and CTA are visible, and measured mobile performance is acceptable.
output_examples.output: All five checks pass. The landing page is ready for the account-level launch audit.

best_practices: Provide the exact live ad copy and destination page used by the campaign.
Supply measured speed and mobile data when available, and label every source clearly.
Resolve each Fix with one named owner before requesting a final launch decision.
anti_patterns: Do not infer message match from the page URL or campaign name alone.
Do not present estimated speed or mobile findings as measured results.
Do not use this skill to rewrite the page or calculate account-level performance scores.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks message match, above-the-fold offer visibility, speed, form friction, and mobile rendering.

faq.question: Does it rewrite landing page copy?
faq.answer: No. It identifies specific gaps and routes page repairs to the appropriate skill.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide the destination URL or page copy, the live ad copy, the offer, and the campaign goal.

faq.question: Can it work without PageSpeed data?
faq.answer: Yes. It labels speed and mobile findings as estimated instead of measured.

faq.question: Does it calculate Quality Score?
faq.answer: No. It checks landing-page relevance factors but does not calculate platform or account scores.

faq.question: When is the review complete?
faq.answer: The review is complete when all five checks have statuses, evidence labels, exact gaps, and repair owners.
